🏛️ 12 Entry Points

Semiconductor Strategy

UK Semiconductor Strategy Governance

Implementation governance for the UK National Semiconductor Strategy. Compound semiconductor leadership (SiC, GaN, InP). Design IP protection. ARM ecosystem coordination. Supply chain resilience monitoring. Export control compliance for advanced chip technologies.

Quantum Computing

National Quantum Computing Programme

Governance of UK National Quantum Technologies Programme. Quantum computer procurement oversight. Quantum algorithm development coordination. Quantum advantage benchmarking. NQCC (National Quantum Computing Centre) integration. Quantum-ready workforce pipeline.

Post-Quantum Crypto

Post-Quantum Cryptography Transition

NCSC-coordinated migration to quantum-resistant cryptography. PQC algorithm standardisation (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA). Critical national infrastructure PQC readiness assessment. TLS/IPsec quantum-safe transition planning. Government key management modernisation.

Export Controls

Semiconductor Export Control Intelligence

Advanced chip export control compliance monitoring. EU Dual-Use Regulation (EC 2021/821) alignment. US CHIPS Act coordination. Netherlands/Japan/UK trilateral semiconductor export alignment. Entity list screening for quantum and advanced semiconductor technologies.

Fab Investment

Semiconductor Fabrication Investment Governance

Foreign direct investment screening for semiconductor fabs. National Security and Investment Act 2021 semiconductor applications. Compound semiconductor cluster (South Wales, Manchester) investment tracking. Clean room facility security clearance requirements.

Quantum gravity sensing for underground infrastructure mapping. Quantum magnetometry for defence ISR. Quantum timing for critical national infrastructure synchronisation. NPL quantum metrology standards coordination. Quantum sensor export control classification.

🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No advanced semiconductor technology export without DSIT licence verification and entity list clearance
  • ❌ No quantum computing procurement without NQCC capability assessment and security review
  • ❌ No PQC migration bypass for critical national infrastructure without NCSC Director sign-off
  • ❌ No foreign semiconductor fab investment approval without NSI Act 2021 screening completion
  • ❌ No quantum sensor deployment for defence without Dstl security classification review
  • ❌ No quantum communications implementation without GCHQ quantum security assessment
